mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate below its 6-month moving average signals an easing monetary cycle, compressing discount rates on equity cash flows and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) when FEDFUNDS is below its 6-month moving average over the past year.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 3.5% triggers investor concerns about labor market weakness, leading to higher interest rate expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns within the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE crosses above 3.5% but SPX 5d returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent growth in both demand (GDPC1) and supply (INDPRO) signals economic expansion, reducing uncertainty and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: GDPC1 and INDPRO both rise by >5% in a month, but SPX 60d returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In a 'late-cycle expansion' regime, even with high FEDFUNDS rates, the S&P 500 forward returns remain positive over the next 20 trading days due to lingering demand-side effects and reduced rate hike expectations.
failure_condition: In the 'late-cycle expansion' regime, FEDFUNDS remains above 4.0% but SPX 20d returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Continuously rising demand (GDPC1) above its 5-month moving average signals robust economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns within the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: GDPC1 increases by >2% in a month but SPX 5d returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sudden surge in supply (INDPRO) above 110.0 triggers expectations of overproduction, leading to reduced profit margins and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO crosses above 110.0 but SPX 60d returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Rising labor demand (PAYEMS) alongside accommodative monetary policy (FEDFUNDS below 2.0%) creates expansionary conditions, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: PAYEMS and FEDFUNDS both rise, but SPX 20d returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In a 'post-shock recovery' regime, combined growth in demand (GDPC1) and falling unemployment (UNRATE) signals a rebound, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns within the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: In the 'post-shock recovery' regime, GDPC1 and UNRATE both rise, but SPX 5d returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05).
